disclosed_findings.title: Chars 9-16 of compromised secret present in validator blob (Phase A0.1R design choice)
disclosed_findings.detail: scripts/audit/validate_phase_a0_1r.py @ Commit B (606dc5d, blob 4573c81) defines SECRET_FINGERPRINT_SUBSTRING = '862b7cf5b001b5b7' (16 chars). Chars 1-8 are public fingerprint; chars 9-16 are NOT declared public. Validator needs the substring for git-grep to catch real leaks; 8 chars is too short (audit reports publish chars 1-8 legitimately).
disclosed_findings.residual_risk: MINIMAL. Credential is DB-invalidated (is_active=0, hash=REVOKED). Chars 17-48 (32 chars) are NOT in any git object. Even with chars 1-16, attacker cannot authenticate.
